## Profile

I am an Economics and Politics graduate from the University of Essex, predicted First Class, with strong interests in data analysis, economic research, financial and operational analysis, and evidence-based decision-making.

My academic and professional experience has helped me develop quantitative reasoning, communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to work responsibly across different professional environments.
